g.text: Source: nine corrected Phase 2 raw episode CSVs · 3,000 episodes per condition. ECDF omits Astra because it is longer; cutoff and mean/median panels include all conditions. Astra had 1,484 cutoffs; others had zero. Filled circles = mean; open squares = median.
